task_completion.description: Scale 'Massive Landscape' to a width of 1200 pixels using the WordPress native image editor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the WordPress 'Edit Image' screen for 'Massive Landscape' showing '1200' entered in the width field under 'Scale Image' and the 'Scale' button being clicked, or the 'Original dimensions' updated to 1200 x [height].

task_completion.description: Rotate 'Sideways Portrait' 90 degrees clockwise using the native editor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the 'Sideways Portrait' image in the editor being rotated 90 degrees clockwise (the orientation should change from horizontal to vertical).

task_completion.description: Set the Alternative Text for 'Sideways Portrait' to 'Professional headshot restored'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Alternative Text' field in the Media Library or Attachment Details for 'Sideways Portrait' contains the exact string 'Professional headshot restored'.

task_completion.description: Create a new post titled 'Meet the Team'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress post editor showing a new post with the title 'Meet the Team' in the title block.

task_completion.description: Include both 'Massive Landscape' and 'Sideways Portrait' in the 'Meet the Team' post.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The post editor or the published post preview showing both the landscape image and the portrait image embedded in the content.
A 'Post published' notification, or the post status showing as 'Published' in the sidebar, or a view of the live URL.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the WordPress native image editor UI rather than external tools or CLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent interacting with the WordPress 'Edit Image' interface (buttons for rotate, scale, etc.) within the browser.

integrity.description: Verify the agent did not upload new images to bypass the editing requirement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Media Library should show the original filenames/files being edited; there should be no 'Upload' dialogs for new local files containing the 'fixed' versions.

integrity.description: Verify the agent interacted with the WordPress admin panel directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's cursor or action highlights are visible on the WordPress dashboard elements, not just jumping to a final state.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target width for 'Massive Landscape' must be exactly 1200 pixels. The Alt Text for 'Sideways Portrait' must be exactly 'Professional headshot restored'. The post title must be 'Meet the Team'. Note: The 'Sideways Portrait' (JFK portrait) may encounter a loading error or appear as a broken image icon due to a known source URL issue; the agent should still attempt the rotation/alt-text steps on the available media object.
